title: Normal: the pharmacy says a prescription is ready

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, this is Maria from Sunshine Pharmacy on Coral Way. Is this Mrs. Díaz?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Your blood pressure refill from Dr. Patel is ready for pickup. We're open until 8 tonight.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Oh good. Do I need to pay anything now?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, nothing over the phone. Your insurance covered it. You can pay the five dollar copay at the counter when you pick it up.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Perfect, I'll come by tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Sounds good. Have a nice evening, Mrs. Díaz.
